item.title: Uniper to Increase Dividend
item.description: Uniper plans a dividend of EUR 0.77 per share for 2026, up seven percent year-on-year, as net profit adjusted for nonrecurring items more than doubled for the first nine months of 2026.

item.title: Türkiye reveals two new oil fields as COP31 opens in Antalya
item.description: Türkiye has announced two additional oil discoveries in its southeastern Gabar region, with President Recep Tayyip Erdogan disclosing the finds as the COP31 climate conference got underway in Antalya.
